description: This Java source file defines the `JournalEntryHelper` class, which provides methods for verifying and retrieving journal entries within the accounting module of the Apache Fineract integration tests. It contains functions to check journal entries against expected data, fetch journal entries by transaction ID, and validate accounting transactions, primarily used for testing the correctness of accounting operations in Fineract. The class is annotated with Lombok's @Slf4j for logging and depends on external libraries like RestAssured, Gson, and Fineract client models.

classes.name: JournalEntryHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing, checking, and retrieving journal entries during integration testing of the Fineract accounting module.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryForExpenseAccount
methods.description: Verifies that a journal entry exists for a specified expense account on a given date with expected entries.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryForAssetAccount
methods.description: Verifies that a journal entry exists for a specified asset account.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryForIncomeAccount
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for a specified income account.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryForLiabilityAccount
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for a specified liability account.

methods.name: checkJournalEntryForEquityAccount
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for a specified equity account.

methods.name: ensureNoAccountingTransactionsWithTransactionId
methods.description: Asserts that no journal entries exist for the specified transaction ID.

methods.name: getJournalEntryTransactionIdByAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID for specific journal entries associated with an account.

methods.name: checkJournalEntry
methods.description: Private method to check for a journal entry with specific criteria within a date range, used internally by other methods.

methods.name: getJournalEntryTransactionId

methods.description: Constructs the URL to retrieve journal entries for an account on a given date, optionally filtered by office ID.
